title: Popular projects are easier to find
summary:
Project stars make the showcase easier to browse, a new image app joins the list, and text conversations stop repeating ads.

Project listings gained GitHub star counts and now put more-starred entries first. Separately, the projects CSV now lists older submissions before newer ones.

ImageGen AI Image was added to the website and README project lists. It uses the Pollinations image API to turn descriptions into images, with prompt enhancement, adjustable settings, and downloads.

Conversation history and streaming responses now skip additional ads when a Pollinations redirect link is already present. The same changeset adjusted affiliate matching and text-response ad handling, moved Mistral Small 3 to a different provider route, and removed requester IP addresses from image-generation response data.

highlights.title: Find popular community projects
highlights.text: Project listings now show GitHub star counts and put more-starred projects first. [Explore the showcase](https://pollinations.ai).
